surface_name: n8n MCP server and package export
title: n8n MCP delete_agent tool is gone and package export ignores includeArchivedWorkflows
symptoms: MCP client reports unknown tool delete_agent
Package export no longer includes archived items when includeArchivedWorkflows is passed
Call to an archived sub-agent fails with an error asking you to restore it
cause: With agent archiving in n8n 3.3, the MCP server tool archive_agent replaces delete_agent. The package export flag includeArchivedWorkflows was renamed includeArchived, and when set, project exports also include archived agents. A sub-agent that is archived stays referenced by parent agents but calls to it fail.
fix: Update MCP clients and scripts to call archive_agent, then delete from the UI after archiving if you need permanent removal. Rename the export flag to includeArchived. Before archiving an agent, check which parent agents use it as a sub-agent and restore it with Unarchive, then publish again, if calls fail.
apply: Replace delete_agent with archive_agent in MCP tool calls, and replace includeArchivedWorkflows with includeArchived in package export requests or CLI options.
affected: n8n 3.3 and later (agents are in Preview)
